about: Official Fenton 2025 growth-monitoring z-scores for made-up head circumferences and lengths at 22-42 weeks, the reference set for test/verify-fenton-length-hc-1116.cjs and the source of FENTON_LENGTH_GROWTH_LMS and FENTON_HC_GROWTH_LMS in data.js. No value here belongs to an infant: each was read off the app's older, unverified rows so as to land near a centile.

source.calculator: Fenton 2025 Growth Plotter, Tanis Fenton, University of Calgary
source.request: The page's "Calculate z-scores" button (POST /api/Fenton/DownloadCsv, 200 OK); one request per sex, rows typed into the page's grid. The text under "raw" is the result table the page showed, cell by cell, tab-joined: the browser tool returned no response body. Each saved text matched a SHA-256 computed in the page over the same table.
source.approvedBy: Pp, in chat on 2026-11-16, for one round of made-up head and length values, both sexes
source.sent: Sex, data type Growth Monitoring, and per row GA, head and length. No name, number, title, date of birth, GA at birth or weight.
source.design: Three rows per whole week, 22 to 42 (near the older rows' 10th, 50th and 90th), from which L, M and S are solved exactly; and 12 held-out rows per sex at half weeks (near the 3rd and 97th, or between the 10th/50th and 50th/90th), which no table was built from.

girls-growth: GA_weeks	Weight_g	W_Z	W_changeZ	W_%	Head_cm	H_Z	H_changeZ	H_%	Length_cm	L_Z	L_changeZ	L_%
boys-growth: GA_weeks	Weight_g	W_Z	W_changeZ	W_%	Head_cm	H_Z	H_changeZ	H_%	Length_cm	L_Z	L_changeZ	L_%
